effect_description_eng:
＜Barrier＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted in battle, by trashing the top card of your security stack, prevent that deletion.)
[When Moving] [On Play] [When Digivolving] By adding your top security card to the hand, you may play 1 [TS] trait Tamer card from your hand without paying the cost. This effect can't play cards with the same name as any of your Tamers.
